findings.contract: acquired fixture/request tasks remain owned and results are observed on all exits
findings.evidence: cookies raw server handles at 63, 151, 191, 241, 299, 354, 419, 475; raw proxy 442. Hint raw servers 49,84,156,223,311,367,533,572,651,732,844,916,973,1016,1045 and request tasks 422/430 span fallible work.
findings.cause: raw JoinHandle drop detaches the actual task and loses its result; normal success awaits do not cover earlier client/setup/body failures or outer expiry
findings.counterexample: after a literal healthy response and actual live-peer readiness, fail/cancel the owning client workflow while an independently held Client/runtime remains alive; the raw server survives scoped owner destruction until explicit backup
findings.remedy: lexically join actual peer/request workflows where driving permits; otherwise use existing concrete guarded owners, bounded finish and typed primary/completed-secondary collection
findings.regression: ordinary/eager/unpolled cancellation after real traffic with finite live-peer/destructor and backup observations; separately release a completed typed actual worker failure before a primary operation failure
findings.limits: source-supported fixture contract gap only; no native leak or whole-old-test false green measured; unrelated cookie_crumbs A152 is a different owner

findings.contract: redirect H2 driver results remain observable during cleanup
findings.evidence: redirect worker spawns first_driver 89 and second_driver 104; abort 110/111 without await or result inspection after wait_for_client
findings.cause: abort does not inspect an already completed poll_closed error or panic; early outer-server failure also drops raw driver handles
findings.counterexample: after real 307/204 traffic, make one actual H2 driver complete with a distinguishable typed error before completion signal; current parent still returns Ok
findings.remedy: own both actual drivers, abort and join all of them within finite bounds, allow only requested cancellation and retain any completed typed errors alongside the primary
findings.regression: real redirect/credential and learned-cookie positives plus independent actual late-read/driver failure and primary-plus-secondary controls
findings.limits: source diagnosis; actual allowable teardown outcomes must be established by root native execution

findings.contract: fixture expiry preserves actual tokio Elapsed and context
findings.evidence: cookie bounded 715–722 and client-hint bounded 1266–1273 replace Elapsed with a string
findings.cause: map_err discards the actual timed-out error
findings.counterexample: poll actual bounded pending workflow under paused time, advance its original five-second limit, then require Elapsed through the real source chain
findings.remedy: retain the exact context through a small concrete contextual error owning Elapsed or use direct await? where no context is needed
findings.regression: actual paused-time expiry, concrete inner-error and ready-operation controls for each helper
findings.limits: fixture diagnostics only; A92 already repairs client.rs, so that owner is not duplicated

findings.contract: ALPS no-second-request observation distinguishes transport/protocol failure from quiet completion
findings.evidence: alps_origin_answering 518–555 matches only Ok(Some(Ok(_))) as failure; every other outcome including Ok(Some(Err(error))) becomes Ok(names)
findings.cause: wildcard success discards a real connection.accept error after the first answered request
findings.counterexample: after actual first H2 request/body and preserved ordinary names, inject a distinct read/protocol error into the existing actual connection during the quiet window; helper returns its names successfully
findings.remedy: match all actual accept outcomes explicitly, preserve typed errors and document the finite quiet/clean-close contract
findings.regression: healthy first exchange and quiet/allowed close positives; actual distinguishable postresponse I/O or non-CANCEL protocol-error negative with backup before causal assertion
findings.limits: no live failure measured; 200 ms quiet can establish only a finite no-request window

findings.contract: the admission-wait test proves the second request reached preparation/admission before learning is released
findings.evidence: second request task 430–434; fixed sleep 436 is the only second-request readiness signal before answer_first release 437–439
findings.cause: elapsed wall time does not establish that the new task ran or reached its queue boundary
findings.counterexample: gate actual second task scheduling until after the first answer; a correct client can then build with newly learned hints and fail the test which asserts old hints
findings.remedy: use an actual request preparation/admission observation and keep the first response held until it is reached; remove the assumed scheduling delay
findings.regression: deliberately delayed second-task scheduling still establishes real readiness before release, then observes no hints on waiting and actual hints on next request
findings.limits: source-supported test determinism gap; no current flake reproduced and no production admission defect inferred

findings.contract: navigation field-order assertions observe exact decoded ordinary wire order
findings.evidence: H2 helper 539 and H3 test 736 collect HeaderMap.keys; order assertions 496–508 and 778–785 use resulting positions; locked http 1.5.0 documents arbitrary unique-key iteration
findings.cause: semantic HeaderMap keys do not preserve an independent ordinary-field sequence or duplicate positions
findings.counterexample: a valid decoded block with a repeated existing name between accept and the expected new hint retains the same unique-key iteration but changes actual adjacent wire fields
findings.remedy: use resolved H2 OrderedHeaders; for H3 first validate/address the missing received-request ordered extension or observe actual raw/QPACK fields; preserve value and first-name assertions
findings.regression: actual decoded unique-field positive plus a valid interleaved duplicate negative requiring the exact ordinary sequence; demonstrate both semantic-map equality and different wire positions
findings.limits: contract/oracle gap, not measured current wrong request ordering; H3 extension availability is independently qualified below

findings.contract: state-learning helpers observe the actual configured high-entropy hint values
findings.evidence: assert_hints 1242–1250 verifies baseline value but only presence for arch/platform-version; client_hint_settings 1114–1124 specifies arm and 15.5.0. assert_http1_hints 1252–1263 tests expected literal presence, so its high_entropy=false branch does not reject a high-entropy name carrying another value
findings.cause: present but wrong high-entropy values satisfy common H2/H3 learned-hint positives; H1 absent-hint assertions test absence of the expected literal rather than absence of the field
findings.counterexample: baseline remains correct and both high-entropy names carry wrong values; assert_hints(headers,true) passes. An H1 raw head with wrong values on those names passes assert_http1_hints(head,false)
findings.remedy: retain exact H1 requested literals, require actual field absence when not requested, and add independently expected literal values to the semantic H2/H3 observer
findings.regression: same actual state transitions with configured literals positive, wrong literal values rejected by the learned-state observer, and wrong-valued unsolicited H1 fields rejected by the absent-state observer
findings.limits: narrow common-helper assertion gap; separate ALPS tests already verify exact values, so no whole-suite false green claim

findings.contract: standards import grouping and single responsibility for identical helpers
findings.evidence: both owners put local support imports before std/external imports; client_hints send_and_drain 1126–1131 and send_client_and_drain 1133–1142 have identical operations and callers
findings.cause: layout breaks supplied imports order; duplicate helper names imply separate behavior where none exists
findings.remedy: move local imports into their existing final group and use the one existing drain helper; manually pace setup/operation/assert paragraphs without broad formatting or crate extraction
findings.regression: source equivalence only; no new runtime tests needed for these mechanical changes
findings.limits: cleanup standards finding, not a behavior defect; large source lengths prompt review rather than mandatory splitting
